ic_device.name: xx555 Precision Timers (NA555/NE555/SA555/SE555)
ic_device.description: Precision timing circuit producing accurate time delays or oscillation; monostable and astable modes.

pins.name: TRIG
pins.evidence: Start of timing input. TRIG < ½ CONT

pins.name: RESET
pins.evidence: Active low reset input forces output and discharge low

pins.name: THRES
pins.evidence: End of timing input. THRES > CONT sets output low

pins.name: DISCH
pins.description: Open collector output to discharge timing capacitor
pins.evidence: Open collector output to discharge timing capacitor

port_dependencies.condition: Output sink/source current greater for higher VCC
Maximum discharge sink current greater for higher VCC
Low-impedance path DISCH to GND when output low
TRIG < trigger level sets output high
THRES > threshold level sets output low
RESET low forces output low; overrides all other inputs
Controls comparator thresholds; alters trigger and threshold levels
TRIG < ½ CONT sets discharge open

functional_blocks.name: Resistor divider
functional_blocks.description: Internal divider generating trigger and threshold levels from VCC

functional_blocks.name: Latch
functional_blocks.description: Set by trigger, reset by threshold; reset input overrides

functional_blocks.name: Output Drive Stage
functional_blocks.description: Drives OUT and DISCH; sinks or sources up to 200mA
